methodologyNotes: 13 notable fitness trackers and smart rings compared by buyers in 2026. Seeds per brief: Fitbit Charge 6 / Inspire 3 / Sense 2, Oura Ring 4, WHOOP 4.0 / WHOOP 5.0, Garmin Vivosmart 5 / Venu Sq 2, Samsung Galaxy Ring, Amazfit Band 7, Ultrahuman Ring AIR. Specs sourced from manufacturer pages (Garmin owner manuals, Amazfit US store, Oura support, Samsung, WHOOP membership pages), official announcements (Garmin newsroom, Amazfit PR Newswire), and authoritative reviews (Android Central, Android Authority, DCRainmaker, TechRadar). US MSRP / launch price used throughout. WHOOP price represents the required One-tier annual membership divided by 12 for comparability (hardware bundled free). Fitbit Premium is optional — noted but not factored into priceUsd. ECG = true only for a built-in ECG app, not passive rhythm notifications. GPS = true only for standalone on-device GPS, not connected (phone) GPS. Water resistance is expressed in metres (static depth). accessedAt 2026-06-15.
